headlines.title: What Is Charles Schwab (SCHW) Signaling By Adding Solana, Avalanche And Chainlink?
headlines.summary: Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) is expanding retail crypto trading to include Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink on its platform. The new tokens are being offered alongside Bitcoin and Ethereum within existing brokerage accounts for eligible Schwab clients. Schwab is positioning the crypto access inside its traditional brokerage interface rather than through a separate standalone digital asset app.

headlines.title: Why You Should Think Twice About Keeping Cash Savings at Vanguard, Schwab, or Fidelity
headlines.summary: Cash in your investment account may be earning less than it could elsewhere. See how the big three brokerages compare with savings options that are almost as easy.

headlines.title: Schwab and Fidelity Need a Death Certificate, a Court Letter, and an EIN Before an Heir Can Sell a Single Share. The Weeks In Between Belong to the Estate, Taxed at 37% Above $15,650, and a Transfer-on-Death Form Skips All of It
headlines.summary: A retired engineer left $1.6 million at Schwab, and his son could not touch it for months while the interest kept piling up. One skipped form turned a quiet inheritance into a surprisingly costly tax problem.

headlines.title: Charles Schwab Expands Crypto Offerings
headlines.summary: U.S. brokerage Charles Schwab (NYSE: $SCHW) is expanding its crypto trading offerings to investors.

headlines.title: $13 trillion brokerage giant offers cheapest ways to trade crypto
headlines.summary: Schwab’s crypto accounts now go beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum, and its trading fee is among the lowest in the industry.

description: The Charles Schwab Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a savings and loan holding company that provides wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody, and financial advisory services in the United States and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Investor Services and Advisor Services. It offers brokerage accounts with equity and fixed income trading, margin lending, options trading, futures and forex trading, and cash management capabilities, including money market funds, and certificates of deposit; third-party mutual funds through the Mutual Fund Marketplace and Mutual Fund OneSource service, as well as mutual fund trading and clearing services to broker-dealers; exchange-traded funds; advisory solutions for managed portfolios, separately managed accounts, customized personal advice for tailored portfolios, specialized planning, and full-time portfolio management; banking products comprising checking and savings accounts, first lien residential real estate mortgage loans, home equity lines of credit, and pledged asset lines; and trust custody services, personal trust reporting services, and administrative trustee services. It provides digital and software based trading platforms; research tools, and multichannel support, real-time market data, options trading; equity compensation plan sponsors full-service recordkeeping for stock plans, stock options, restricted stock, performance shares, and stock appreciation rights; retirement plan services; mutual fund clearing services; and advisor services, including interactive tools and educational content. The Company operates through branch offices. The Charles Schwab Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Westlake, Texas.
